about.title: About the Wilds Unknown set
paragraphs: Wilds Unknown is the 12th Disney Lorcana booster set, released on 15 May 2026. It has 243 cards: 204 in the main set, 18 Epic, 18 Enchanted, 2 Iconic and 1 Illumineer’s Quest cards. There are also 204 foils, one for each main set card.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 204 main set cards), the Master set (408 cards, adding the foils) or the Grand Master set (all 447 cards, adding the Epic, Enchanted, Iconic and Illumineer’s Quest cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
